title: Vinyl-Mind
intro: Vinyl-Mind lets several stations learn together: each turntable profile shares only the weights and counts of its learning model, never audio. The shared model comes back and is only used where it does not estimate worse on your own master recordings.
contribute_help: After each retraining, send the weights and counts of every turntable profile (see What is sent). Never during a recording.
contribute_off: Contributing is off. Nothing is sent.
use_help: Fetch the shared model, check it on your master recordings and use it as the starting point of the training where it does not make the estimate worse.
use_on: The global model is fetched and checked.
use_off: The global model is no longer used.
url_locked: Leave the server to change the address.
url_reset_done: Server address reset to the default.
server_key_help: Fingerprint of the server's signing key. Compare it with the one the operator publishes.
state_revoked: No longer known to the server
model_unused: Version {version}, not used: not better on your master recordings
model_idle: Version {version}, not in use: the imported starting point replaced it
prior_none: none, the training starts from zero
prior_inactive: not in use while Use the global model is off
prior_remove_confirm: Remove the starting point? The learning model is trained from zero again.
waiting_recording: A recording is running. Vinyl-Mind waits until it has finished.
join_no_url: Enter and save a server address first.
join_unsupported: This server does not accept this station's feature version {version}.
joined_pending: Registered. The operator still has to approve this station.
send_now_hint: Send changed contributions and look for a newer global model now.
leave_confirm: Leave this Vinyl-Mind server? It deletes this station's contributions. Joining again creates a new station key.
forget_confirm: The server could not be reached ({error}). Forget it on this station anyway?
preview_hint: Exactly these payloads leave the station, one per turntable profile. The profile names are shown only here; audio, record titles and names are never sent.
files_hint: Without a server, knowledge can travel as files: export a profile's contribution here and import it on another station as its starting point.
imported: Imported. The learning model is retrained with it as the starting point.
